name: Degenerative disc disease
aliases: degenerative disc disease of the spine

suggestions.rationale: Where imaging and neurologic findings show nerve-root involvement, lower-extremity radicular symptoms are commonly explored alongside degenerative disc disease.
evidenceGaps: Neurologic exam findings and imaging correlating with nerve-root involvement
Documentation of sensory, motor, or reflex deficits
Opinion linking the neurologic pattern to the spine condition

suggestions.rationale: Radiating leg pain is frequently documented in lumbar degenerative presentations and may be explored as part of the same secondary theory.
evidenceGaps: Clinical documentation of radiating pain distribution
Objective findings supporting sciatic nerve involvement
Opinion connecting the sciatic symptoms to the disc disease

suggestions.rationale: Chronic pain-related sleep disruption may be relevant when records show ongoing nocturnal pain and reduced sleep quality.
evidenceGaps: Sleep disturbance history tied to pain episodes
Opinion addressing whether chronic spine pain aggravated sleep impairment
